system.name: COMPAS recidivism risk scores (Broward County, Florida)
system.owner: Northpointe (now equivant); scores as published by ProPublica
system.description: Commercial risk assessment that gives each defendant a decile score from 1 (lowest risk) to 10. ProPublica obtained the scores given in Broward County in 2013 and 2014 and matched them with criminal records over the next two years. This audit treats a decile of 1 to 4 as a low-risk (favourable) decision, as ProPublica did.

use_case.purpose: Assess the risk that a defendant will reoffend, to inform pre-trial decisions.

opinion.statement: Controls over this AI system do not yet manage its key risks. Release should wait for remediation of high and critical findings.

results.title: Risk classification
results.summary: EU AI Act tier: high (Art. 6(2) and Annex III point 6: Law enforcement); the Act is used as a benchmark (no EU deployment declared). India context sensitivity: high (score 7/10), shown as a benchmark (India is not a declared deployment region). No risk tier was declared by the system owner. 0 upcoming regulatory milestone(s) apply.

results.recommendation: Record the classification and its basis in the AI inventory, have the accountable executive sign it off, and plan for each upcoming obligation.

results.title: Data quality
results.summary: No data-quality issues above thresholds. Note: evaluation_data: 15.6% of rows are identical to another, but the data has no record identifier, so they may be different people with the same values; reference_data: 13.5% of rows are identical to another, but the data has no record identifier, so they may be different people with the same values.
results.plain_summary: The data supplied for the audit is complete and consistent.
results.recommendation: Document how missing values are handled, de-duplicate records, and confirm no input is recorded after the outcome it predicts.

results.title: Predictive performance
results.summary: AUC 0.710 (95% CI 0.699-0.722) on 6172 held-out rows is above, but its 95% confidence interval reaches below, the declared minimum of 0.70. Accuracy 0.661, F1 0.691 at threshold 0.65.
results.plain_summary: The model tells good and bad outcomes apart correctly about 71% of the time, which meets the bar set for this use.
results.recommendation: Track AUC in production monitoring with an alert at the declared minimum.

results.title: Calibration
results.summary: Expected calibration error 0.134 (limit 0.05; equal-mass bins 0.132), Brier score 0.238. Worst group: race=Other with ECE 0.194.
results.plain_summary: Risk scores do not match observed outcome rates closely enough to be read as probabilities.
results.recommendation: Apply isotonic or Platt calibration on a held-out set and re-check per group.

results.title: Group fairness
results.summary: race: DI 0.53 (African-American vs Other, p=2.18e-39), EOdds diff 0.38 (observed outcome rates differ by 0.27 between groups, so equal error rates and calibration cannot both be met; choosing which governs is a policy decision); sex: DI 0.92 (Male vs Female, p=0.00185), EOdds diff 0.03; age_cat: DI 0.46 (Less than 25 vs Greater than 45, p=3.72e-106), EOdds diff 0.40 (observed outcome rates differ by 0.24 between groups, so equal error rates and calibration cannot both be met; choosing which governs is a policy decision). Thresholds: DI >= 0.8, equalized-odds difference <= 0.1.
results.plain_summary: Applicants in the 'Less than 25' group (age_cat) receive a favourable outcome 36% of the time versus 78% for 'Greater than 45', below the four-fifths benchmark.
results.recommendation: Investigate the drivers of the gap (see proxy-feature results), consider reweighing or threshold adjustment, and document a fairness rationale approved by the risk owner. Attributes needing action: race, age_cat.

results.title: Intersectional fairness
results.summary: Worst pair race × age_cat: DI 0.33 between 'African-American × Less than 25' and 'Other × Greater than 45' (p=4.51e-28); lowest single-attribute DI for the same attributes is 0.46. The intersectional gap is larger than either attribute shows on its own.
results.plain_summary: The combined group 'African-American × Less than 25' is treated less favourably than any single attribute reveals.
results.recommendation: Report subgroup metrics alongside single-attribute metrics and set an explicit subgroup tolerance. Collect more data for subgroups below the minimum sample size.

results.title: Proxy-feature screening
results.summary: 2 feature/attribute pairs exceed proxy AUC 0.7: age→age_cat (AUC 1.00), c_charge_degree→race (AUC 0.72).
results.plain_summary: Some inputs (e.g. 'age') closely track 'age_cat', so the model can discriminate indirectly even though that attribute is excluded.
results.recommendation: For each flagged feature, document a business justification, test model variants without it, and compare fairness and performance. Remove protected attributes from inputs unless a documented legal basis allows them.

results.title: Robustness to perturbation
results.summary: Skipped: Perturbation testing needs the model, not just scores
results.plain_summary: Not tested because the required input was not supplied.

results.title: Data and prediction drift
results.summary: Compared reference data with production_data (1827 rows). 0 features with major drift (PSI >= 0.25), 0 moderate. Largest shifts: age (PSI 0.05), priors_count (PSI 0.02), juv_misd_count (PSI 0.02). Score PSI 0.016; favourable-decision rate moved from 56.5% to 52.8%.
results.plain_summary: Incoming data still resembles the data the model was validated on.
results.recommendation: Re-validate performance and fairness on recent labelled data, review the drivers of the largest shifts, and set PSI alerts in production monitoring.

results.title: Decision drivers
results.summary: Skipped: Feature importance needs the model
results.plain_summary: Not tested because the required input was not supplied.

results.title: Personal-data exposure
results.summary: No direct identifiers detected in any dataset supplied for the audit.
results.plain_summary: No personal identifiers were found in the modelling data.
results.recommendation: Drop or pseudonymise identifier columns before data reaches modelling and evaluation environments, and record the purpose and lawful basis for any personal data retained (DPDP Act 2023 purpose limitation and data minimisation).

results.title: Membership-inference risk
results.summary: Skipped: membership inference needs the model's training data as reference_data; this is a predictions-only audit, so set reference_is_training: true if that is what it is
results.plain_summary: Not tested because the required input was not supplied.

results.title: Documentation and claims
results.summary: Skipped: artifacts.documentation (model card YAML) was not supplied
results.plain_summary: Not tested because the required input was not supplied.

results.title: Audit self-test (canaries)
results.summary: 6/6 self-tests passed (6 planted defects, 0 false-alarm controls). balanced copy, then halve favourable decisions for race=African-American: DI 0.49 after 952 decisions flipped; balanced copy of race is not flagged (false-alarm control): DI 0.98; shift age by 1.5 standard deviations: PSI 7.61; two random halves of the data on age (false-alarm control): PSI 0.01; plant 5 e-mail addresses in 100 values of an unnamed column: scanner run on planted column; a column of customer references is not flagged (false-alarm control): not flagged.
results.plain_summary: The audit tests caught every defect deliberately planted to check them, and raised no alarm on clean copies.
results.recommendation: Tune thresholds or test design for any canary that was missed before relying on results.
